chunks: And from him, from Abi Sa'id, who said: Narrated to us Nadr ibn Ali, who said: Narrated to us Ali ibn Ja'far, from his brother Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) took the hand of Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn and said: 'Whoever loves these two boys and their father and their mother, he will be with me in my rank on the Day of Judgment.'
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for loving Hasan and Husayn according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: This narration from *Kamil al-Ziyarat* highlights the Prophet’s physical gesture of holding Hasan and Husayn’s hands, symbolizing their immediate inclusion in the Ahl al-Bayt’s spiritual hierarchy. It underscores the Shia doctrine that love for the Imams is not merely emotional but a means of attaining the Prophet’s own rank (daraja) in the Hereafter, linking familial affection to eschatological reward.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 13. Muḥammad ibn ‘Abdillāh ibn Ja’far Al-Ḥimyari narrated to me from Abī Sa’īd (Ḥasan ibn ‘Ali ibn Zakariyyā Al-‘Adwi Al-Basri), from Nasr ibn ‘Ali, from ‘Ali ibn Ja’far, who said: His brother, Mūsā ibn Ja’far (Imam Kāżim (a.s.)), said:

The Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.) held the hands of Ḥasan and Ḥusain (a.s.) and said, “Those who love these two boys and love their father and mother will be with me in my position on the Day of Judgment.”
